message: The package, target, module, or source-contribution graph is not one closed deterministic graph.
fixit_policy: manual review of package, target, module and source-contribution identities
notes: R4 primary reason set: PACKAGE_TARGET_MISSING, PACKAGE_BINDING_AMBIGUOUS, PACKAGE_CYCLE, MODULE_MAPPING_MISMATCH. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: Module contributions do not form one conflict-free item-skeleton set.
fixit_policy: manual review of duplicate declarations and overload-slot keys
notes: R4 primary reason set: DUPLICATE_DECLARATION, OVERLOAD_SLOT_KEY_COLLISION, MODULE_CONTRIBUTION_CONFLICT. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: A dependency, import, export, re-export, signature, facade, or static dependency binding is not closed.
fixit_policy: manual review of the exact dependency and interface binding
notes: R4 primary reason set: IMPORT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND, IMPORT_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS, IMPORT_ALIAS_COLLISION, EXPORT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND, EXPORT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, REEXPORT_CYCLE, EXPORT_VISIBILITY_LEAK, MODULE_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH, FACADE_WIDENING, STATIC_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE, STALE_DEPENDENCY_RECEIPT. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: The resolver scope tree or one of its separated environments violates the closed lexical-frame law.
fixit_policy: manual review of lexical name, activation and evidence frames
notes: R4 primary reason set: SAME_FRAME_DUPLICATE, PARAMETER_BODY_LOCAL_COLLISION, IMPORT_LOCAL_COLLISION, ILLEGAL_CROSS_FRAME_OVERLOAD_MERGE, NAME_ACTIVATION_ENV_CONFLATION, SCOPE_ESCAPE, FAILED_PATTERN_PROBE_BINDING_LEAK. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: Reference collection did not produce one admissible candidate set in the required namespace.
fixit_policy: qualify the owner or repair the imported/exported binding
notes: R4 primary reason set: ZERO_CANDIDATES, MULTIPLE_SAME_TIER, WRONG_NAMESPACE, STATIC_PATH_UNRESOLVED, STATIC_PATH_AMBIGUOUS. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: A collected reference is outside its visibility, activation, member, or evidence-origin domain.
fixit_policy: manual review of visibility, activation and evidence-origin domains
notes: R4 primary reason set: CANDIDATE_NOT_VISIBLE, ACTIVATION_SCOPE_ESCAPE, ACTIVATION_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, MEMBER_VISIBILITY_DOMAIN, API_VISIBILITY_LEAK, WITNESS_ORIGIN_INVALID. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: The resolver cannot select one deterministic noncall reference outside the callable-overload domain.
fixit_policy: qualify one exact noncall owner; callable overload selection is a separate phase
notes: R4 primary reason set: ZERO_AFTER_FILTER, MULTIPLE_AFTER_FILTER, ORDER_TIEBREAKER_REQUIRED. Callable overload sets remain analysis-HIR input to the next cluster. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: Resolver output is incomplete and cannot be admitted into canonical HIR-H1.
fixit_policy: resolve every noncall reference and attach its typed identity and visibility proof
notes: R4 primary reason set: UNBOUND_PRIMARY, UNRESOLVED_COUNT_NONZERO, CANDIDATE_SET_COUNT_NONZERO, MISSING_TYPED_ID, MISSING_VISIBILITY_PROOF, RUNTIME_RELOOKUP_RESIDUE. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.

message: The normalized module interface or dependency receipt does not match its required digest identity.
fixit_policy: rebuild the dependency against the exact normalized provider interface
notes: R4 primary reason set: MISSING_EXPORT_EDGE, INTERFACE_DIGEST_MISMATCH. Product execution remains NOT_RUN.
